::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [1890s?]  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge VIII 2
:::

My dear [Mr Warburton](people/person_1466.qmd) 
Alas! I wish I could be in two places at once, for I do not at all want to miss the Committee which is enjoyable and instructive- But I have been engaged for weeks past to a [GFS](organizations/other_23.qmd) meeting, and I can’t get off for I have a note from [Mrs Elgee](people/person_475.qmd) this morning that her speaker one at least fails, & I must do it. Whereby it is all the more unavoidable and unpleasant!

In haste - with [Mr Green](people/person_1647.qmd) looming on us in this dismal wet

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge
